title: TinyDebug
description: A clean client-side debug overlay without the F3 wall.
body:
![A blurred Minecraft village scene at dusk with a centered dark square containing a cyan pixel-art “TD” icon. Below it, large white text reads “TinyDebug,” followed by the cyan tagline “Clean debug info, without the F3 wall.”](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec76c3556e3a295d9da81e8a38cdc90b1534ad83_0.webp)TinyDebug is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that gives you the useful parts of the F3 debug screen without covering your entire display.

It provides clean, debug information for casual players (like me!). You can view coordinates, facing direction, biome, FPS, memory usage, light level, target block info, Nether/Overworld coordinate conversion, and your last death position.

# Controls:

- F8: Toggle overlay

- F9: Cycle preset

- F10: Copy coordinates

- Hold F7: Expanded overlay

### TinyDebug is client-side only and works on vanilla servers.
